snippet.title: 7 Shifts in Subway — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
7 Shifts in Subway is a psychological horror game where observation, memory, and quick decision-making are the key to survival. 

Learn the rules, recognize impossible events, and make it through all seven night shifts before it's too late.

Coming Soon... to PlayStation 5
